body:
This high school student got permission to paint her school’s “spirit rock” with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk. Then school officials came after her.
The fight to keep men out of women's sports isn't over.
_Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.conservative-today.com/s/u/pp55_WZdQki9Fbu-ULZZ-FWRTNRxgYgFF9G4EYNWgdTO5lpOHHJuzBULLJC_VOjTSoIg244QCoY1JoSXetWOmY44Tq8WQRmQW2DDWstyQhO2MUl5OO-bu3h9Q0FygQGaleuUgej1tTt-5LKKsY8gmpt6ekS5NiR0TVUSxqJqeUgZTyYcFBuVCy8f/MouI7bGIP9CfRaFJ7ZxWgazFgqz9GccR/23)_
| | | [](http://links.conservative-today.com/s/c/iQLdXMqHjvWCcyGQUitJlYphP5q-V5tnfPwi2xpAnq25U0X8wwYJxAj8NEZy45FJ05g_BsZJgWEzh7yyMsElpIxpwciNMleD4p8r48J4xfd3rT7fQvA9ex6bKQy_NmuYwPf3Egyw_znSgWfWMNs3S4sO-r8SopQo_GDFVpc8LL58rSlIy2_ZBRkXQhEGSQqkTLG596POcnMPBq0fDxlQnk5J5Yy3YUZm1BtcEYlgGM6h9vGU44CT3FPXvaFlqakhTvRNEtyqUNuP1L5b70T6xaM2hy4gmOAreg3VrzfPX1ANq4vLLGVTK7UO-gzHd8eWW4EEsA_sROvLDD6yX7rDQGhH7o_kNKP862Qc_Fm81Fi5Oc6xWI1ilFuwrW4iNw_2CJlBV79YqPMz0UIl5RoXKMxO_ywvmtg_YZ3duDowHTCot989-FBj1yEU7DOP-Fei-N8tzZ0TF7E5SzN-zIbOgdjXkmaPTUy2Y3bg8vy8C-_7_-0D0kxq3QiqOyw0M12w2Ai4fgUfkd7XmIYz6ABWeQTzwYNDQisRDckjv1aIQLMCeV9Pk-qn-EIX2soYUVpPKPSLL1GD1bCUUcd5aMgbVU20CcfCUhP1YemRQ9QOtJ8SumCNa5FN3iYjdiRZRyUacFCZx76ZB57shKQ_6PAqUhlo6pul53NuJWoiqCLPHj4U9AsPa85rEBf6Iqx3YUKyLcsQ8pSb8oFbAjTL1d3aavgXPf1J/wEO7mKmPM6vfKTYaihAZRlejK5rsTllf/23)

Dear Friend of Truth,

Imagine waking up to this message from your high school:

"Vandalism to school property. Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation."

And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth.

[ GIVE NOW](http://links.conservative-today.com/s/c/4AjOuMAju62oC1_qUkXfrdEQuWUbD_IjN1WZcTQbYXG98V4YYWBOHI5vI5gBDHlbsavj5LVa3zgsQhV_0SmEwgIUPU7Y8tBgHav0LSuCYlm-p3cGoRk7gIn9cOIAxy2OOuUkKC9x1RjKbR__r1aEkPcpvNZnDDI2mXwTFEaGjaVrutBXsLaqBX2en_s408yQwDNuf4Ax041RbCjuuxhYHalhxXOTs1B7U-ADzU53ZIU4Wqp06iF_NAHTF3ubKGn8_86aT0q9cy2dlUfngMmhaAerpSrmptvB1tBaqQUOQWFpYUyOzvPTkFW7NyeOGVkS1JDt8QFGrvl3ZwMB_2VprBHW2De7vP-FpJibjXgDIcNnpxV010MB0wXLP_V2I1srPwZsROgacPCBBK-LAc0BakEJRl-lit1YJWkW5Tf4rRERuzPLEaY2-BA4lmGAZJDBYwcCqiaB_OaDeMe_RicMHE8MP7KYLKFit0mBDIbP6oQhcugqPL1du1_hqUoBPENw6FxsJAacjJXmcHPewVd4F9Yc1cdndmChcI79dec-NGHT1FQaI9qvX1CIdBKGKbaze-DstM6IJKdPrOZ5pH-XriJHu-MWaL2LnqhOeX1po9dhucqRByl7pObGtZohnfhuuUyHIPGGcU5xneDVoGV7ufdfmpSeRUpbciHXr7hoefPVu_DgMJRMhCrGbUXq7iE9RflVFE1zwGEmxyNsvKTITuP357MD/c4fTR2LF4JYYGndBLgPJ_Lejxzuq72rX/23)

That's exactly what happened to Gabby Stout. She had expressly asked permission to paint the message--and the school had given it.

**But the next day, after she and her friends painted the rock with the messages "Freedom 1776" and "Live Like Kirk--John 11:25," school officials sent out a school-wide email accusing them of vandalism and launched a criminal investigation.**

And it got worse. The local news widely reported on the "vandalism" and "investigation"--and school officials hauled Gabby into an office and forced her to write a statement describing her actions and show them her phone logs.

School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation.

The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer.

Of course, Gabby and her friends had NOT committed vandalism. So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and __released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. __

A few days later, the school unveiled a "Revised Spirit Rock Speech Code" that only allowed "positive school spirit" and messages that "uphold the inclusive values of our school community."

**It explicitly bans students from expressing religious or political messages on the spirit rock --and allows the school officials to subjectively decide which messages are "positive." **

The Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education, which targeted and unlawfully investigated Gabby, violated her First, Fourth, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendment rights.

**These school officials cannot be allowed to get away with harassing and accusing a high schooler who did nothing wrong --just because they disagree with her views. **

Alliance Defending Freedom is suing the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education to make sure it will answer for its blatantly unconstitutional actions--punishing students for their views. But this is a lot for a high schooler to go through--so we want to make sure she knows that she isn't standing alone.

A generous Ministry Friend has stepped forward with a matching grant that will double any gifts given while funds last.

**Will you stand with Gabby and help us make the most of this matching grant with a gift of any size today?**
[GIVE TODAY](http://links.conservative-today.com/s/c/HGlYBAEYCmTenjWOTDo_f3VfbzeYIyrxLBJKHtdyB8BdoYliEflHmrt2fwlXRC7kwOWMqCvvlNdktAJl-ARrGmjZ6FGZfGGd1v1KFAErR9HdZ0hXDd7nxxlzXwVqib5wZPMxEZtbjCApPUMq3u8nyO4hkJY-oG0ACCPdMVKTuHuAHv3uW4w6Xlffqs6kPXomUmit8HD9hqD12nviksH8RpCxcqdQNK8wRFReBPLp_NRPu1Z-R9ndVzK21cBTKrrE_MAL3iZrCKurz5h3y2e210xpxsc9KXoCTul8btF9GhgqJR0m_vd5Gup5wp7a9OrZ00fk_8k35t4XKcdzByz1-f-vbNt1U6ykVmLG-ibXNHAJ7gbioQXVm4HdqMDcJvB0jae3NZahZ5ZDTPPUIsuZheDxkPnJEkH4D-e4DdzMVMAN8o6cfDJPi7Q6x1i3-pJO-66NgcbgNuUf8b1hAt3QlhuRe9sh-SIibQ3IdKOxP9-9uuwzjOtIRwX53Zxli-5dr2NA7PwtViQSvEsxnVO2vDRKu9rUatbA3H8ZfPMYiAPYrnW-58l6l9xaFbFN7ezDhZhKuwBVXNJjTO1ZU5EeQmw5OM0UIlPImWrlf742fNJvqVN9VR5FLE3DJ1nQyc1iCTEF0D0p_oBfNXIaVbC5xM6j4Fosgw_6UEocuAl1W0auVrlo-Y2I5bsi_9DwEb_dnrW0BIbHM3tYxe80AtIZ5DY7x8o6/PMS1wpxzYOynMKm4irv2Isx-KkjeoicG/23)

Charlie Kirk was a monumental figure to young Christians like Gabby--and none of them should have to suffer for wanting to honor his legacy.

Your support is appreciated!

For truth,

clean_body: This high school student got permission to paint her school’s “spirit rock” with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk. Then school officials came after her. The fight to keep men out of women's sports isn't over. Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | Dear Friend of Truth, Imagine waking up to this message from your high school: "Vandalism to school property. Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation." And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth. That's exactly what happened to Gabby Stout. She had expressly asked permission to paint the message--and the school had given it. But the next day, after she and her friends painted the rock with the messages "Freedom 1776" and "Live Like Kirk--John 11:25," school officials sent out a school-wide email accusing them of vandalism and launched a criminal investigation. And it got worse. The local news widely reported on the "vandalism" and "investigation"--and school officials hauled Gabby into an office and forced her to write a statement describing her actions and show them her phone logs. School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation. The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer. Of course, Gabby and her friends had NOT committed vandalism. So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. A few days later, the school unveiled a "Revised Spirit Rock Speech Code" that only allowed "positive school spirit" and messages that "uphold the inclusive values of our school community." It explicitly bans students from expressing religious or political messages on the spirit rock --and allows the school officials to subjectively decide which messages are "positive." ---
| Brave Books And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. | | | | | Dear Friend, **Will you help me put God back in your town schools?** **[Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that:](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYn1BbRTolqHsQGdd1cedqD0-06uHy5Z_rv7LLZxvwA3Ppcz_G0aGkCKgPhPxscmk9I9X2pr9WfzVLPkRe4Ezo_DWtzdqGa5bkDCw)**
---
| | |
* They are wonderfully made in the very image of God.
* And that God is calling them to love Him above all else.

---
What a country we’d be, if all of America’s children had just a little bit of God’s Word in their lives - like _you_ did. Our Founding Fathers understood this. That’s why throughout our history, the Bible has been the cornerstone of American life, education, and law. Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was “the best gift God has given to man.” And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, “Without God there could be no American form of government, nor an American way of life.” But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools. He wrote that the ruling didn’t ‘protect religious freedom’ but rather ‘established a religion of secularism.’ And how right he was! But even Justice Potter wouldn’t have predicted how far the ‘religion of secularism’ has taken us from Biblical values. **[Your signed “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition is so important because instead of the Ten Commandments, the Beatitudes, and the Golden Rule being presented in schools...](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYo7iNsfrLbIIx9A5ehGoXdp95PpVu4s6P1kzjHEsNXuNTNXm53ijhy9vN8oXu3DLTGJOdtgViRIQjdVmNuxF23TKh8mH1vwa7EXg)** ...today radical “educators” teach our children and grandchildren that:
---
* God is a myth for the weak and if their families believe in Him, they’re probably uneducated, hateful, and racist.
* If these “educators” do acknowledge God, they say He makes mistakes and some boys are really girls and some girls are really boys.
* And they wrongly tell children, ‘God just wants you to be happy’ so you should do whatever you want, do whatever feels good, and anyone who tells you otherwise is an old- fashioned bigot who has to go.

---
So many families are being torn apart by this madness that overturns everything our Founders believed. **It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools.** **[That’s why I’m spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYpoYtexNMs3fAxcIyvNDdWzopwgT7rne9DKv8_xRZI5ZTtGF2my1o1FxezL86818Fane3dPOMAllJHUTKgQKQkphZwh6cOhJkaEQ)** Your signature on your “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition tells our elected officials that you want biblical lessons put back in our public schools. Think public schools are too far gone? Think I’m dreaming? Consider this... **[Your signed “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition is going straight to my friends at BRAVE FOR GOOD.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYqmhh7SWElmGiKrKaNQIQa0eFo9IKdDG-nHqThHGjBJOsM2VWU3TNmDxkiFbH6hkTDXdwbMhz8SlExxiYp_a3ybpItHq9PHjBS3A)****[_With your support..._](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYrPN9JTSStdOboNIs3vz1OfKk_raT3NPiUKX0jYh_INJQqHnvNWscyvDsmnrES9UvJzzzhrSJUAc6E1PZGrB0S8j4C2UcEsPN2ZQ)****BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group behind my “See You at the Library” movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”**BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year!And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish – and that America was founded upon – back into public schools this year! _HOW?_ We’ve designed a mini-curriculum for America’s 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation’s Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. **With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America’s 250th Anniversary.** You know it won’t be easy. The radical leftists who’ve taken over our public schools aren’t just going to put out the welcome mat. That’s why **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed **[“Schools Need a Bible Revival”](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzF9AAwAAAAAAmQyUJYsMdl1DcP6ZoPgpmzSMnnoIAJ_NM4AgUxfLPzJc7y80ZBmvCRcTsIud3ca3YInsUMBnpyN2iei3mQPFCVPN8JI44tIg7ooA4Bonw) **petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. ---
| Unless we do something —**the Supreme Court appears ready to issue a dark slate of rulings** in favor of: a national abortion ban, an extreme crackdown on immigrants and birthright citizenship, a repeal of LGBTQ rights, and more.

| By 2065, _our next opportunity to regain a liberal majority_ , the America we know today will no longer exist:

---
| And if Trump places two or three more justices before his term ends, 2065 becomes a floor, not a ceiling. That should terrify you. _It terrifies us._
---
| **Regaining the court conventionally is no longer feasible.****** The only path forward for Democrats is taking _unprecedented_ action to break the conservative stranglehold over the Supreme Court.
---
| _This is why Defend Our Courts exists._ Our plan is the only way forward for Democrats — and it works on two tracks simultaneously:
---
| **Track one:** Win state Supreme Court races to build the firewall that protects voting rights, blocks gerrymandered maps, and holds the line at the level where elections are actually decided. We beat their machine in Pennsylvania. We beat it again in Wisconsin. We have more races to win in November and beyond.
---
| **Track two:** Build the political will to unpack and reform the United States Supreme Court — which requires winning House majorities, Senate majorities, and the presidency, because we need all three to expand the court. It’s how FDR built the Supreme Court that upheld his _New Deal_. This is a multi-cycle fight, and it starts now.
---
| Neither track is easy. Neither is cheap. Both are necessary. And we have already proven the model works. What we cannot do is run this program without you.
---
| The children being born today will be adults in 2065. The America they grow up in — whether their voice matters, whether their vote counts, whether they have more rights or fewer — is being decided right now, in elections most people aren't paying attention to, by a court most people aren't watching.
---
| **Taking back our courts is the** _**only**_**way we ensure the country our children and grandchildren inherit is one that we would recognize.**[ Can we count on you for a contribution of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare — to ensure Democrats adopt the path of reclaiming this court by any means necessary?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Mbbr-qa3UpkTYWumcBtfaQKJ-wp-p5uH1rhzxtDYmnALPPiPT_YEoEz3UhCpfJ_yUk7D9tTpdA45yRhiLxo1AkrUK66Gar0Jk1X8Dz1ybObOQjrls9nQ8QCrngWMdQBIKbepbGBiI6GBR8D87i-f7D0X4YFnJN9B1GRtFGFx5-oJFESPoGT73vESUcuFDKNns3Ud4JQr-HeybyJK12xIqMco-yyCsVVHz4iqMh0ShcFo1FQN9kXDExELwPAAxqM4&c=745Rpqziailx7_2nU5XYKL9vhxpEubQdX4QoOdRApQ7JLk-Oa2iBBg==&ch=b59aVkjcirvHuXm1rG7IgOamFgSTEwSDZqqP1S18ln2StPbbycdmzA==)

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1978, three balloonists from Albuquerque, New Mexico, [touched down in a French wheat field](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSpCAUgOHTYKb1QEUICDox6003pJ7y1NeL0CV0d-3tp2auMBf4_6rv793fkSOn_Q-e5OqWfaJPiVQrXT5ixINrOfCDzP9e5Uh0nUTVK1C6BdPKyeNa-U1-wCa4jUhR35CTk9FWS2lsc7iRxg22YPthWLSetkmCtIMETVIPCEvD7rsHRk4SQCvTjYs2xoZF66DtGIwYgALXfHWPzKketMX_-U1Xt-azie6o9VlEfxNqFmpGvjCF8sSVusIdhZdQ85pjpLVyTm1eHrTWItS85xRyxDbk1xKpJdwjtUqoOWE5_U3aycLYKwBoLheeH46Ri57EAPuJHH_u9Zdob6e-AgAA___yoYCi) after 137 hours in the air, completing the first crossing of the Atlantic by balloon after 17 earlier attempts had failed. Today in _Finance_ , we meet an 18-year-old who [buys abandoned storage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu3CAQheGnwR0W4F2MC4o07m7alNYYxmYSjC2YXeu-fbR5hdRH-nT0__pavoAylf0nHOh5O5eCd8vIjHXJkCERtwQ3EP15tVSwHoi8GGWsVE7qcYHA9MblAV30G6LBoUOvR2cnq7WbuuTXaYIhbMpACHo026RhGKewjnGDR9RjR_7jKadHrZQ1rn-u1rkprtZGOz2jEw-Fkfis_e-TCifc8vf5xtqH8-iyT8xXE8MPYWZh5vu--1DW8BmFmT-0MLNywszaCDMzYmmyUUSZXo0zyi3TdVHZZeOzwo7yVYibXCuVvUkqUg9PpZQE-Y1Q-8RH7qqP1005U7OjeKj9AMr_7vB_Vnx78zcAAP__50uG1A) units without knowing what is inside, then sells whatever he finds. He brought in about $135,000 last year. Let us know in today's poll whether you rent one, and be honest about the last time you opened it. How does the military decide who's tough enough to become a Navy SEAL? Why does it take a full year to train someone to fly a plane that never leaves the ground? And what exactly happens inside the school that teaches Americans how to survive being captured? The military doesn't advertise most of this, but the answers are out there, buried in Navy attrition reports, Army training records, and firsthand accounts from the people who made it through. Today on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla digs into what that paper trail reveals about how America really forges its warfighters. ## Lala Kills 1, Sweeps Away Hawaii Homes
Tropical Storm Lala [killed at least one person](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAQhp8Gb0SAbYwHhi7e0rWjRcw5XIMhgkuivH1F-wjdTjr9n_7v_zqvZ4cR0_XTHWBpz2uCV41ABGWNLrqAVIN7OcTbo4YE5QCgVQmluTBcTqvbCJ-wDq7zdgdQ0Hdg5WT0rKU0cxfsNG9qGkF532_agxl7sfduksM4i80p06FtPGHkJIXQypzGizZm9hetvZ5Hb9ggwCPlcvrOmCjAHt_5CeW05aOLNhDdK-s_mFqYWtL7niu1F1NLAzO1CMPUItv1qLwZMrWERym4ucSbJsfE_zT5DWOs3BGP4CrxnIB7qFTyu_KQD2jZrlh_f2GMWPXEBnE9HMbfNvTPEZ9W_QQAAP__x1aGVw) and cut power to more than 200,000 customers across Hawaii after its eyewall brushed the Big Island on Saturday evening. The storm passed offshore as a Category 1 hurricane [without making landfall](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu5CAQxvGngQ4LWINxQXGNu732SmvWjJe5YHsFeFHePnLyCKlH-mt-37_7fAdKtD__woa-rse8YysJa8U8J0gQqZYIDYg-zhJ3zBtinbXUVkgn1DDDUumNcw88-BVR442jV4Ozo1XKjTx6NKtxS2-G3ox2sEo7edPSmR5B2WAcJ3_1pFODktJq15mHdW4MD2uDHU1wrJcYqB65-3_QXiOu6fN4Y-6WY-PJx1pfhd3-MD0xPbXWupYhXUemp8vD9AQvpqd45kwL7CgumkhQIhbxwxPHjiIgBAHn8yxVXD8xPfHsw6tRSlTswHr53IC-27z-cq-3118BAAD__wa6fvg), but flash floods swept homes off their foundations near the island's southern tip and high winds ripped roofs from buildings across the state. By Sunday morning, roughly [197,000 customers were without power](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHyoyAQxp8GOxxAg1hQXGOXa690CK5hLygOrGHy9jdeHuHfbbG73-_7_bnPd4cR9-dvt4GlNc071BKBCPIcXXQBqQRXHeLrLGGHvAHQrITSXBguh9l5wjfMvWsWuwIo6BqwcjB61FKasQlWr0OnhffeKBgHrz2swsm1X8F5P_Zdg_b6J4wcpBBamfb20MaMy0PrRY-3xbBewIKUcvs34U4B1vhJb8itT1sTbSA6Cut-MTUxNdVa2y_xVWVP9dpiaroymJqEYWqS13SkCpmnk9wTCsftcJ64MS_-vebhzBm924FfInhw2wG58JMwIn24z1ALU1OT7XJUjBGLHlgvnpvD-J-Mfij0bdW_AAAA____1oyQ), with Oahu hardest hit. Hawaii Gov. Josh Green declared a state of emergency, and about 100 mainland utility crew members are due Tuesday. Lala weakened to a [tropical storm](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGu4yAQRb_G7rAAO4ALF9uke9tuaWEYzGwwRDCJ9f5-5ZdP2HLOjEY69_75Wr8sJsz7b3vAQqGsGc6WgAjqmmyyEalFe1rEx6vFDPUAoFVyqRg3TOjVOsI3rJPt_RIAJIw9LEIbNSshzNzHRbhpMkGoUfvZBgl-1DB7pbfAJyUm0-Ny_eNGaMG5kma4bcqY2W9KeTXfvOkmDh6p1OFvwUwRQvoub6iDK0eflkj0bN34q5P3Tt7P8xweSO9reY1gKULt5D2-akVnMzAHmX4QVesemHd2qTKq5YnOJtao1OPDtop5byykUvx1aLNn-6vRNzsx-8aosE88nbzbSugSrKDl6DcNzPkQ2DS6mc3gNAvKjlx5EeCmh0hH6uvinyemhE3pbuL7YTH9SNF_dvFe5L8AAAD___B0oTo) Sunday and continued tracking west of the islands. Tropical storm warnings remained in effect for Maui County, Oahu, and Kauai County, with another 2 to 4 inches of rain possible across much of the island chain and isolated totals near 6 inches.
## Commander Visits Strained USS Lincoln
Adm. Brad Cooper, the top U.S. commander in the Middle East, spent several hours aboard the _USS Abraham Lincoln_ on Saturday and [acknowledged mental health problems](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uxCAUBODT4A4LsBdwQZHG3aZNaWF4XsjyszLPa-X2kXOFdCON9Gk0X_flbmOK5fFpMxjc6lLgbAkQYV-STTZEbMGeNsbn0UKBPQPgIpiQlGnK1WIdxjcso-282QAEDB0YrrScJOd66oIZleVCbt5tw6C4GiehGOMKBq31CtPWRXN5THPFGZNC97dVaj35VUovp5vXZGTgI9a9_66xYIAt_dQ37L2ruUsmIL4aGT6ImImYz_PsXVndVRIxXzQRM9NEzPxKWF_0aNTVnG3xsFPrnqWeCfwDGs1Q0CYawCYMNLZ2QKO10KM1mmJxNZU-YE7dbvzrjCnFJhUZ2SPbmP724D9vfBvxGwAA___uCIfO) on the carrier after nine months at sea. The carrier has been in a combat zone for [more than 200 days](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd6ww9mJcUGyUuLtpUqS0juHs5ST8rIBdlLePvK9wu5FGGs33_f7YP4ACpc-fENG0e94T9hqwNSx7gACeWvXQgejvs_qEJSK2XQqpuNB8XHawjV64zzA4c0eUOA1oxkWrVY2jXgdvYNZ2tkLoGQBhsmrSdjkE6Hm6ru6QA5lzT-hxGYVQUl-uh9J6dYdSTq1Xp9ks0FHL5fInU2oe7-FffmG52ByHYHxrj8qmG5Mbk1vv_RJrOjsmN0z8WZncTiwmt3emAol3KNzmGCE5LPxFlVrlzSN_1srhKOAh8kDJ5pCY3KDw202CG8cfbNqyJcem799OcdjrLyyPoRj36BQCVbWwWXxGoPA-2L7o9WXk_wAAAP__QViOLg) with a single two-day port call, and phone calls home were restricted when the threat level rose. At a San Diego town hall, one spouse said her husband messaged that "[he hopes he doesn't wake up tomorrow](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnDAQRk8DnZFtjDEFRRq6P21KNItn15OMzcqeXZTbR5siF0jzNZ_09PR-fO1fQEzl8R0yrnI_94JXYxTBujMwJJKW4AKiX6-WCtaMKLvV1isdlJl3OITeuDvo43pHtDj2uJo5-MUbE5Y-reDBGROmxR3jON6nMEc3j-6YrTM3DWNP64eng5mN1t6GYbr5EJZ48z76ZYqhcxojyVmHnycVSXjn3-cb63Ccuec1iTxbN37r7NbZ7bquoUmlJ7bP39lNEoJgbZ3dXp_5Z286u8GtQoKsmMpxclGZYmRUCE1UxiLAKiGwJCXnVVQCZvVpQOWhrJ20H50bkmTu6xqfFzFT83Pn9CMD8V9D-c-w79X-CQAA__8fyoyx)." Families also described moldy showers, broken toilets, and soap shortages. Cooper said the carrier has one of the [lowest numbers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ_GdF4ZL2tMQZGG7qZNiQY8vp5kjFf27KJ9-4i8Qrr5kc6n8_36Wr-AmI7vn5BxlljWA8_GKIJ1ZWBIJC3BCUR_Xi0dWDOirNZYp43X_bjCLvTGdYAuzBHR4r3DuR-9m1zf-6lLs3-4OA447d7HHYKN27SN7uHiZIYYpntH85VnfD_2xjjrb4_NeT-FzbngpkfwajAYSEq9_S50SMLIn_LGettL7nhOIs-m7j-UXZRdzvO8xVI3bNdb2aWRYFN2yVA_tSCXGK_1Yiq7GK_s0l8ThEwVWO8MlJt-taZhq5Aga6ZjL3w0nfEQYJ0QWJLeoWHTUFFXZLg88EdzOXXA9iS5zs9SBYPeKzW6qF2dw_MkZmpuVIP5zkD8r4f8p_73bP8GAAD__4rJnWU)[ of mental health cases](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ_GdF4ZL2tMQZGG7qZNiQY8vp5kjFf27KJ9-4i8Qrr5kc6n8_36Wr-AmI7vn5BxlljWA8_GKIJ1ZWBIJC3BCUR_Xi0dWDOirNZYp43X_bjCLvTGdYAuzBHR4r3DuR-9m1zf-6lLs3-4OA447d7HHYKN27SN7uHiZIYYpntH85VnfD_2xjjrb4_NeT-FzbngpkfwajAYSEq9_S50SMLIn_LGettL7nhOIs-m7j-UXZRdzvO8xVI3bNdb2aWRYFN2yVA_tSCXGK_1Yiq7GK_s0l8ThEwVWO8MlJt-taZhq5Aga6ZjL3w0nfEQYJ0QWJLeoWHTUFFXZLg88EdzOXXA9iS5zs9SBYPeKzW6qF2dw_MkZmpuVIP5zkD8r4f8p_73bP8GAAD__4rJnWU) in the fleet, though "this doesn't mean that all is perfect." The _Lincoln_ was due home in May, and the carrier is finally heading back**.**
## Eight Nations Fault Israel on Gaza
Hamas leaders told Jared Kushner they remain [committed to disarming](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuxCAURE-DO1vAegEXFGncbdqU1rf5mJ-AvQKyzub0kaPcIN1II73RvLfbdAOKtK2vkNBWv08bHiVirZinCBEC1RLgAKKPzxI2zAmxTpJL1XLTCj3BUumBUw-Nsx5R4qVBK7RRgxLCDE2wHoVw3mtQXsAVYHCa90rPC--X2ZihIXvyuBFacK6k6a6zMmZws1JODVdnWM_RUd1z977TVgP6-NwfmLtlT020odZ7YZcXJkcmx-M4OviivZwtk-PJZnLkhslRnOnvSBsgQWlX-IbWUYGcIOFWW1yf99pSyYCxydbdD4qRitKs52sCir-r9Z-yHlb-BAAA__-zHX8j) Gaza in a 90-minute meeting in Egypt on Sunday, the first such talks since October's ceasefire. Former British Prime Minister Tony Blair also attended. Hours later, eight countries, including Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Indonesia, [blamed Israel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOnDAQxvGngc4rbFhjFy7S0F3alGhYD3jujE3s2UXk6aNNHuH6T79P-v_6mD-AIqXtJ-zoeM1zwrNGZMYyR4gQiGuAE4i-njUkLDsiz6pTWnRGyHGGB9ML5wFa71ZEhX2LTo5GWy2lsW1wPehRS22HQT96c7eLBUTwd7sC9IvEltzb64wcZddpZW73RRtj_aK11_buTTN06IlzuX1mShxwjVd-Ybk98t5GF5iP2vQ_GjU1ajrP88a0Y80r1QIY36tGTZFeuMS8zZi4XI2acLsOFp-5eEjiCSh-A0MR_CxfeInMAUsVS4QdxX9IrLkIDicUprSJDf6AOBAeKI4IqVFTW5w_ToqRqh6bodt2oH_3LX-z7cupvwEAAP__zF2TPA) for obstructing the peace plan and urged Washington to enforce Israeli compliance. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected the 15-point disarmament framework last week and says Israel [won't withdraw](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGynDAMRb_GdGaMFowpXKSh27QpGYEFKDH2jtEuk3x9hvcLrzuF5uje--s5PZEjp-0nHuRlzVOi64wkQmWKGHFnOXe8kPnP-9wTlYNIJjBgtXG66SdchD80tVgFvxIBPSryTe_sYJvGDdXubbd0OGNLc0tocQEbgoWHAVp7mIOt2N8-45q-McaCq7vZOjeE2dpghy441RoKLLnUvzMn2WmNf_OHSr3ko4p-F3md6vFDwahgvK6rlp0SCueE8e5z3ykYb1QwHpRQwXj_VDAap2BsbuKzIEW95BToSBT0movO8ynlvQinTb8IF9K0rrmI5qQ3_HeLquLD6-IY-bS9as12IMevaPLNRT8e_gcAAP__TW-MOg) from Gaza until Hamas is completely disarmed, leaving the two sides at an impasse. Hamas avoided the word disarmament in its own statement, describing weapons as being [handed to mediators](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO2zAQRU8jdWNQtE1RBYs07jZtSmEsDsWJKVIgxxI2pw82yA22__jv4f36mD-QE-f1J27kJJQ509kSiVCdEyaMLC3iicyvd4uZ6kYks1bagLIwjDMuwgfNN-y9C0Sarj25YbRmMsNgpz66QIvWesThbrx6-sXc9DiYq9UTaaWuU8_u60_ZYRyUMtpe7k9j7eSfxngz3b3tboo8S6mX34WzRArpsxxUL0vZ-uSiyN66649OPzr9OM_zIrxRK4FbRUpfq04__vtDxA0bLJEpAGeg9XMXCKWCYHo1KBnQH5gXzitIfW97gxX_IOwJM7APsJQsnN_UoEnlF7VOP_rq_H5yStzM2N3UuiH_A_fyzaqH038DAAD__0-8kB8) for transfer to a Palestinian committee. Kushner meets Netanyahu today.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1915, a Category 4 hurricane [came ashore at San Luis Pass](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1yhCAUQOGnwW4dwB-koEhjqk2bkkG56J0gOHDjbt4-s3mFlKf5ivN5t3eHEdP24Q4w9AzZJnjUCERQbIEDjgUKpi24GCGdGDNVLa3kcrzx6SaUdSvhBbZ3jTcL91o0YISaRj32g-LNblQYJj-BWiDoMAQFYV3HVaqg-KAHrxs0L45PQgnBZa9bLUat-46LRU-q6zrWc_BIubS0A8HT1RB_8gWlXfPRRLMTnZV1b0zOTM6Q2gd-4QkeXZvLxuT8aiZnocVg3128oFJOdv8uBVeXoCnGnw-MEeuoWM-3w2H8s-m_Ty4jfwMAAP__6nl2kQ) with 130 mph winds, killing 275 people along the Texas coast. Galveston's seawall held, but 90% of the island's homes outside of it were destroyed. Hit reply to share any whoppers about the biggest one you landed (or that got away). How does the military decide who's tough enough to become a Navy SEAL? Today on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla digs into what that paper trail reveals about how America really forges its warfighters. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykzzFuwyAUgOHTwBYLMDG8gaFLtnTtiLB5xEgYLPzkJLevWvUG3X990v919_eQS66Pz7Cho1dqvuLzKEiE3XfccJux5_pIoRSsey6NDlBeCTVdhL1I48NC-USvA49uFhEkRyeNnWDSVyP46rS1kBJAuArUFhYVAWSyerYxJR0sz-6HE1YaKYXSMICcAPQo5AzWjOPItMCYqfWBViR8hSOVdzuxD0vbeHEr0X6w8YOpG1O3jnMPNQ7lzdTtL9xb7LhgJd5d3J-5lHxMhmnx2EIuvwz9d_906jsAAP__TF9vPA)! ## Lawmakers Press Abbott on Big Bend
More than 40 Texas House members from both parties [asked Gov. Greg Abbott](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvSpCAQhZ8Gs7YA8UJAsInZbLqhhdJq16BY2DvOvP2Wk-wD_Gl3nct3_jyGh6dI-_Lbb-j4Padhx-uMyIx5yLjhNmKmfZl9jLgfFBOfVg9a6gZkB6od_MT0wsH4IrhRBqsKdKrtGtuYupXF6kKjmjq0Cn2lZyur2hscu8nWtQkKayzI3XayU61SUhtbWtVYayqpRtu1VVUJIzEQp1zyioxvf87xk16YyyltRXQr83GK6pfQvdD9dV3l8-33-yl0f_MI3X9lcKRITNP_w5IOiP7a_BMzHBkDTXzCTZv-Mswpw0onHD7zB-5EGGmBEfcAY8oBM1wpP4Xui-zCcVGMdDatMHLZPMVvPf7prC-n_wUAAP__CQuPCA) Thursday to help halt border barrier construction inside Big Bend National Park. The letter says the park's mountains and cliffs already form a "[God-given border barrier](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7oeiCIBwSZmvemGFshTqUWx4E3b8_dT9i9MfG-dW_f8e05PF1M81r9uR0vvJU8HXjUhEZap4I67xxKPdXEp4XHGlKkaOUmQPYeBCz25meILJ-WaYD0EIxq0Qg-96VWnodnsoAAW3XVKGSMAQou90IvulgU7H3Buor1xMAgtBEhlHkb0xqgWhDeDbtuWKcAQKZcHbUj4dnVJ3_mF5THnvUl2Izora_8wOTI50oZbTOnOmBy3vON9icmxkiPkl6N5Y3LsoRVDZ_iHx5O7dvcfS-VfZUXuvM9EvFI-uc8lYOHelRLvgo8r93gEJsem2HBeMaVYe80UrLuLn-GGfivzZeVPAAAA__9S-Ymw)," with drones and radar handling the rest. Rep. Eddie Morales Jr., D-Eagle Pass, said Texas "should not bend the knee" to the federal government. U.S. Customs and Border Protection Commissioner Rodney Scott said the agency [isn't building a 30-foot wall](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSniAUBeCnwQ4HkBUpKNLYbdqUDuhF7wTBgRvd_-0zfyZvsP0355w5vz6XT48J8_7Tn-DoK5Ylw9MSEEFdKpxwBqiY9-hTgnxhKtSsWpRQIxcTl2bxK-ENi_bd5oLYrOzASTONdtQfRnSHUwBRR6G0NML6IEFOMRhhhY6Dh_jRoXvHiUkaKYXStrdytFYPQgY7mWEYmBawIZXa0wEEX77F9Co31H4tZ5fcQXQ1NvxgamZqfp6nv99zXytkqj69FVNzKHWDyitcpRJT8xouvh4IkVfwMWI9G_9vHp8Sx8ZzIR4A887DH0zEPfGAOw-QN375-rsxNXfVbdeDKWEbDdNiPz3-q-zou4feTv0NAAD__-KxjMI) or stadium lighting there, and that the bulldozers people spotted are doing survey and design work. CBP is adding one access road, improving existing ones, and installing cameras and vehicle barriers. Abbott's office hasn't said whether he'll act. A spokesman said rugged areas like Big Bend are "great opportunities to deploy technology" to secure the border. A Lipan Apache nonprofit and a Terlingua outfitter [sued Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOrCAUxvGnwQ5zQAUpKG5jN7fd0qAeHTIIBs4Ms2-_mX2Frb_kly__r9t8cz74ePx3J1p672mOWEtAIsxzxhPPBbOPx-5CwHj5kKgYOUuQisPIhZ7dSv6Fc--azS6wGdGgFXpURvWDhuZuxejQABgDnQKl9K7VOvTDIA1qte268fbDwSi0ECB70xqhjOk7EIsZddd1rAfcPKXc0h0J367s4Tu9MLdrOptg70RXYd0_Jicmp1pr-1jo_RmZnD42kxOMTE5iYHIKrpanJ14QH4UXShdf_MEXjBtfUt4w8-pC4GuKhfJzJZ8ik1OT7XZVH4IvSrMejtP58HuA_hruZeVPAAAA__8x34CL) to block the work, citing damage to archaeological sites.
## Killeen Schools Mourn Fallen Pilots
Both Fort Hood pilots killed in last week's Apache helicopter crash near Salado [grew up in Killeen ISD schools](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0TGu3CAUheHV4I4RYDCmcJHG3Uub0sJwGV-9a7AAjSe7jyZSVpD6l4706fz62r48EubnT3_C0t-pbBnuRtA71K3CCecOFfMzeSLIF1LpzalNCTVxMXNpNx86vmDTfojLLqKTAyzSzpObtLFiOJYAfgYpjU9ag3ZJGqOlmic9jVZ6IwZcPnNillZKobR7ODk5p0chdzfbcRyZFhCxl_roB3R4-5bod3lBfYRyDrQcvV-NjT-YWpla7_t-fENu5lOZWn3tGAiYWj80plYqwdMnZI45VIi4E_ALaiuZp4qQY-P_7DyV2vlRSuStUESojX8jEUR-AGEoV4fKQ_XtYGo1QnCRTFTGOa61VVw7bfluVOB7TKNxxk56dkNd4nUjEbbJMi2ep0f6q-n_-8JrUX8CAAD__4-Jmh4). "_We share in the grief of their families, friends, fellow soldiers, former classmates, and all who knew and loved them_ ," Killeen ISD officials said. "_We are proud they were part of the KISD family_." Chief Warrant Officer 2 Deontre Huey, 34, [wore No. 30](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFu7CAURL8Gd1hwwWAKite429emtLC5rFGwWWGy7P595Ej5gnQjjXQ0cz5u883FFI_7f7ejra-Q5wPbmbBWLHPBHfcFSzzuwaWExyOmXE8DMzBQlI2U69mtNT5xlq7zdmHe8A4t16MySg6adZuVRghwg8YlDJ4PMCi_suAVLhrNAKGL9sKxkWvOGUjTG66MkYLxxYxaCEEkQx9rLn3dsOLLnSG98xNLv-a9S3ar9XES8Y_ARGBqrfWfrb6uksB0sQlMbCQw8SuFXHYsdM1u3ejvxZOuDajHfNSCdPvCN03oPBaaQ6AhYvIEpq5Y_2gxpXgqTSS77y6mnxH1r_KeFr4DAAD__yfVgn0) as a running back at Killeen High, graduating in 2011 and joining the Army in 2014. Former coach Sam Jones said Huey wasn't handed a starting job but competed his way onto the field by his senior year. _"He didn't give up,"_ Jones said. Warrant Officer Seth Olmstead, 25, of Belton, graduated from Harker Heights High in 2019 and had just married his high school sweetheart. Friend Logan Faber, who called him "an incredible person," said Olmstead flew small planes with his grandfather and always wanted to fly. subject: A huge development in our Senate race
body:
What just happened in North Carolina.

This news changes everything, Peter. Let me explain.
**As I write this, the GOP is going all in to defeat me.** President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and personally attacked me on social media, Stephen Miller recently went on Fox News to rant and rave about me, and dark-money groups are putting millions behind baseless ads lying about who I am and what I’m fighting for.
Republicans are coming after me so hard because experts say that if we lose here in North Carolina, Democrats will lose our chance at taking back the Senate.
Unfortunately, these attacks are working – a recent poll of this race shows my narrow lead cut to only 4 points – and the GOP is continuing to strike while the iron’s hot.
**Recently, the Senate GOP's top super PAC launched brand-new TV ads all across the state, which they had originally planned to start airing in _September_.** They’re ramping up their efforts to defeat me earlier than expected, and now, they’re spending more in North Carolina than any other battleground in the country.
**I need your help, Peter. We’re getting outspent, and without your immediate grassroots support, we could put our shot at flipping this seat at risk.[_If you care about winning in North Carolina and retaking the Senate, making a well-timed donation of $5 to my campaign today is the best thing you can do to help me fight back and win. name: Darline Graham
subject: A mother, a grandmother, and a wife
body:
I am ready to work hard for you and help further President Trump's agenda in Washington. |
---

Fellow Patriot,

I never dreamed I would be in this position.

Just over a month ago, I was just a mom, a grandmother, and a wife. I was not in the public eye. I was helping my youngest daughter get ready for her final year of high school.

I’ve spent my life serving South Carolina from behind the scenes. I’ve run a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. _I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars._

I did not think I would become the first female United States Senator from South Carolina, but when President Trump asked me to serve, I knew I had to answer the call.

clean_body: I am ready to work hard for you and help further President Trump's agenda in Washington. | Fellow Patriot, I never dreamed I would be in this position. Just over a month ago, I was just a mom, a grandmother, and a wife. I was not in the public eye. I was helping my youngest daughter get ready for her final year of high school. I’ve spent my life serving South Carolina from behind the scenes. I’ve run a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars. I did not think I would become the first female United States Senator from South Carolina, but when President Trump asked me to serve, I knew I had to answer the call. Fellow Patriot, we have just days left before the runoff on August 25th. I am up against a career politician - and I have only been running for weeks. Because after this Runoff Election, we have to look to November. My Democrat opponent has been raising millions since the passing of my brother, Lindsey. She’s been using the Primary Special Election and Runoff to say, "the road to the Senate Majority runs through South Carolina." She could be right if we’re outraised by millions. Thank you and God Bless, Darline Graham | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. Hello, I hope that your summer has been great.
My sons went to academic camp this summer. I am Asian after all. I went to the same camp when I was their age. That's why I'm President today.
Dropping them off made me nostalgic for summers from my youth. Do you have songs you associate with summers long-gone-by? I certainly do, with the summers of 1988 - 1994 particularly prominent. The anthem of this academic camp is "[American Pie](https://substack.com/redirect/a20afa79-6271-44e0-b529-25e4b8e6d8f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" by Don McLean, so that song is embedded in my teenage soul. It gives me joy that my kids now know that song too.
Maybe the biggest change from my childhood to now is that it's too hot to let kids run around outside all summer long. I remember spending countless hours outside during camp. Just running for entire afternoons. Now, you'd better have a pavilion or a fan or air conditioning somewhere.
Lazy days and warm nights. I miss the World Cup, even though I'm not the biggest soccer fan.
This summer was my reality TV premiere. As you may know, I'm now off the show, officially not the [Nation's Dumbest](https://substack.com/redirect/2971a6f4-454b-4b65-b498-2c3663853bee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It was a lot of fun pulling up on the sofa on Wednesdays with my family watching the episodes together. We'll still do it to root for my friends from the show, though I kind of know what happens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/84bb4f00-e6b5-49bc-b332-30238718d00f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My niece upon watching Nation's Dumbest asked my brother, "Daddy, what is Uncle Andrew's job?" It's a good question, one I get all of the time.
(By the way, my official job title nowadays is CEO of [Noble Mobile](https://substack.com/redirect/563afffe-8743-4cfe-98a1-448b69985ffb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is saving people money right and left. We get the average user's cellphone bill down to ~$40 a month and reduce your screentime by 17%. We also pay 5.5% interest on your savings! For 3 months off your mobile bill with Noble Mobile, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/0f0f7674-4a4b-4afa-8012-f6228530b73c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or email [matt@noblemobile.com](https://substack.com/redirect/b7bde39c-8aa9-4a06-bc0d-87205ca3e8ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and use my name to switch or explore. Plug ended.)
Another big part of summer - the movies. The [Odyssey](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae78b17-d4b4-4a7f-893f-b9a49234df2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Spider-Man were definitely the hits of the summer. Whenever I'm borderline on bringing the boys to a movie, I do it because it feels like they'll form memories.
I conducted a social media poll asking people how their summer '26 has been. The results were 30% fair, 29% good, 21% not good, and 20% great. Those results were a bit better than I expected, given the grim economic climate. Credit card delinquencies have spiked to 13% and school loan delinquency to 11%, both heading upwards. The summer politically has had a real [anti-incumbent](https://substack.com/redirect/c61e9d5e-b761-4aa8-912e-234ca64fed76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) bent.
As if on cue, Anthropic is heading to a Fall IPO valuing the company at over a trillion dollars. It's going to be one of the biggest stock offerings in history. Anthropic is much more of a pure AI play than SpaceX was, which will give us a sign as to what inning we are in of this particular buildout boom. I suspect we're in one of the later innings.
My summer's not over yet. I'm heading to Birmingham, Alabama for a charity [event](https://substack.com/redirect/e3c3a1dd-1ec3-45d2-8414-26aa33f322d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for invisible disabilities this weekend and then to Yellow Springs, Ohio for a comedy show. One of my boys is celebrating his birthday this week too. Going to try to stretch the summer through Labor Day, which falls reeeeeeaaaaally late this year.
Look up this summer, there's still time to make a good memory or two. The Fall will be here soon enough.
This week on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/68f47326-6859-469d-b289-f9033217bd91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) we have Professor of Human-Computer Interaction Steven Rathje with Michael Chad Hoeppner from the Hudson Valley Ideas Fest on how tech use affects our brains. name: Rob Riggle, American Veterans Center
subject: Join me in keeping our heroes’ legacies alive
body:

Fellow Patriot, here's something you should know: AVC doesn't take a single dollar of government funding. **Every documentary, every oral history, every story we preserve exists because of patriotic citizens like you.** And AVC has the track record to prove it. Recently they recorded several World War II veterans who shared about fighting in the Pacific theater, including:
* **Bob Wilson, 105, who enlisted in the Navy shortly after Pearl Harbor. **Just three years later, he took part in the D-Day landings at Normandy. Bob was awarded the French Legion of Honor in May 2025 for his valor.

* **Roberta "Randy" Tidmore, 103, a trailblazer in the U.S. Marine Corps Women 's Reserve.** Randy was a Rosie the Riveter who later served as president of the Women's Marine Association, advocating for the recognition of women's contributions in wartime.

* **Calvin Shiner, 102** , who served in an all-Black engineering battalion -- building bridges, repairing roads, and helping hold the line across Europe.

Right now, AVC is preparing to film several helicopter pilots who flew dangerous missions in Vietnam, as well as members of the legendary Night Stalkers. In November, they're hoping to sit down with many of the World War II veterans attending AVC's annual conference, heroes like:
* **Milton Ripple,** a U.S. Navy veteran of USS Pollux, operating throughout the Pacific Theater...

* **Dominick Critelli,** who served with the 95th Infantry Division, landing on Utah Beach on June 12, 1944...

* **Robert Boeke** , a veteran of the U.S. Army's 341st Infantry Regiment of the 86th Infantry Division who took part in the liberation of the infamous concentration camp at Dachau.

And this work is in addition to reviving and hosting our nation's largest Memorial Day event - the National Memorial Day Parade, which draws more than 300,000 spectators to Washington, DC in salute of our nation's fallen heroes! **I can personally vouch for AVC 's work, Fellow Patriot.** I've been the subject of two of their documentaries myself, and I know firsthand how seriously their small but mighty staff take the responsibility of capturing a veteran's story.

I did two tours in Afghanistan, and in 2013, I retired as a lieutenant colonel. While I retired my uniform, giving back to those who served -- and ensuring these men and women feel supported, heard, and celebrated for their sacrifices -- is a key part of my life.As long as I'm alive, I'll be proud to have earned the title, "Marine," and I will feel loyal not only to other Marines but to all Americans who've served our nation.

clean_body: Every day, we lose more veterans’ stories. You can help stop that. AVC preserves veterans' voices through powerful documentaries--but only with your help. | | | | Fellow Patriot, I'm Rob Riggle. Some folks know me from 12 Strong , Step Brothers , The Hangover , 21 Jump Street , and other movies. But before Hollywood, I spent 23 years serving in the United States Marine Corps. Above: Rob Riggle and Edward Shames, veteran of the 101st Airborne and the last living officer from the famed 'Band of Brothers.' I wouldn't trade a single moment of that service - the good, the bad, even the painful - because it shaped who I am. It gave me confidence, resilience, and a deep respect for every man and woman who wears the uniform.That's why I'm proud to stand with the American Veterans Center (AVC).Their mission is simple but urgent: preserve the firsthand stories of America 's heroes, guarding their legacy and honoring their sacrifice, before they're gone forever. In fact, this year will be my eighth year hosting their televised event, American Valor: A Salute to Our Heroes in November.But I'm writing to you today because every day, more veterans of World War II, Korea, and Vietnam pass on.When they do, their voices and their stories of courage, sacrifice, and grit risk being lost to time.Unless we act now. Fellow Patriot, here's something you should know: AVC doesn't take a single dollar of government funding. Every documentary, every oral history, every story we preserve exists because of patriotic citizens like you. And AVC has the track record to prove it. Recently they recorded several World War II veterans who shared about fighting in the Pacific theater, including: Bob Wilson, 105, who enlisted in the Navy shortly after Pearl Harbor. Just three years later, he took part in the D-Day landings at Normandy. Bob was awarded the French Legion of Honor in May 2025 for his valor. Roberta "Randy" Tidmore, 103, a trailblazer in the U.S. Marine Corps Women 's Reserve. Randy was a Rosie the Riveter who later served as president of the Women's Marine Association, advocating for the recognition of women's contributions in wartime. Calvin Shiner, 102 , who served in an all-Black engineering battalion -- building bridges, repairing roads, and helping hold the line across Europe. Right now, AVC is preparing to film several helicopter pilots who flew dangerous missions in Vietnam, as well as members of the legendary Night Stalkers. In November, they're hoping to sit down with many of the World War II veterans attending AVC's annual conference, heroes like: Milton Ripple, a U.S. Navy veteran of USS Pollux, operating throughout the Pacific Theater... Dominick Critelli, who served with the 95th Infantry Division, landing on Utah Beach on June 12, 1944... Robert Boeke , a veteran of the U.S. Army's 341st Infantry Regiment of the 86th Infantry Division who took part in the liberation of the infamous concentration camp at Dachau. And this work is in addition to reviving and hosting our nation's largest Memorial Day event - the National Memorial Day Parade, which draws more than 300,000 spectators to Washington, DC in salute of our nation's fallen heroes! I can personally vouch for AVC 's work, Fellow Patriot. I've been the subject of two of their documentaries myself, and I know firsthand how seriously their small but mighty staff take the responsibility of capturing a veteran's story. You see, they don't just point a camera and click "record" without a thought. They honor your service...they listen...and they preserve your story with care so it can inspire generations to come. Fellow Patriot, during my years of service, I was deployed to Libya to help evacuate the embassy.I was among the bucket brigades at Ground Zero after September 11th. I did two tours in Afghanistan, and in 2013, I retired as a lieutenant colonel. While I retired my uniform, giving back to those who served -- and ensuring these men and women feel supported, heard, and celebrated for their sacrifices -- is a key part of my life.As long as I'm alive, I'll be proud to have earned the title, "Marine," and I will feel loyal not only to other Marines but to all Americans who've served our nation. Above: Rob Riggle and Dick Cole, veteran of WWII and Jimmy Doolittle 's co-pilot on the Doolittle Raid. Fellow Patriot, AVC does tremendous work honoring the legacies of veterans through their Oral History Documentary program from all branches of service. These brave individuals selflessly risked their lives to safeguard our freedom. It's up to us to honor their unwavering dedication and ensure that their legacy of sacrifice is forever remembered and held in the highest esteem. Fellow Patriot, I 'll be honest--without you, these legacies may vanish. With you, they'll live on to inspire millions.Our veterans stood up for us. Now it's our turn to step up for them.Thank you for honoring their service by helping us tell their stories.Semper Fi, Rob Riggle on behalf of American Veterans Center United States Marine Corps (Ret.) body:
Anti-Trump is not enough
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=35%2E42639%2Eb9MNGw)
Look around.
Donald Trump's poll numbers are in the basement and somehow getting lower every day. The American people are fed up with rising prices and a never-ending war in Iran, and are tired of working hard and seeing that their life doesn't line up with what their hard work should afford them.
They look at a political system where all branches of government are controlled by Republicans and they think, rightfully, that these people do not care about me and my family.
So what do we do now?
There are some who believe that Democrats should just sit back and let Republicans defeat themselves. That we should just scream "TRUMP BAD" and the rest will sort itself out.
I disagree.
And I say that as someone who Donald Trump threatened to imprison, and he called for my hanging.
Democrats have a chance to seize this moment to restore the American Dream. Yes, opposing Trump may help us win an election in November. But offering an agenda that takes on corporate power and brings hope and real change to the working class of this country is the way to build a Democratic majority for a generation.
What does that mean?
It means rooting out corruption in Washington wherever we see it.
It means that in the richest country in the history of the planet, people should have health care and we should pass Medicare for All.
It means that we've got to get super PAC money out of our elections because there is nothing more corrupt than money in our politics.
And it means that we need to fundamentally change our economy into one that puts hard work at its center.
Yes, we need to tell the American people that Donald Trump is bad.
But we also need to tell them what we are going to do ... and then we need to do it.
Once upon a time, Democrats took on the robber barons of this country with the New Deal.
We broke their stranglehold on politics.
We can do it again.
Don't give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

| | **The Interim US-Iran Ceasefire Formally Expires Today With Negotiations Deadlocked and Trump Preparing New Sanctions ‘Aimed at Forcing Iran to Surrender.’ Here Is Why the Removal of Restraint as Pressure Escalates Matters for You.**
---
| | A significant deadline arrives today: the interim ceasefire agreement between the US and Iran is set to formally expire, even as negotiations to end the conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz remain deadlocked. **The expiration removes the last formal framework restraining the conflict, and it coincides with President Trump preparing new economic sanctions aimed at forcing Iran to surrender — a convergence that makes today a genuine inflection point rather than another incremental escalation.**
---
| | For your portfolio, the ceasefire expiration matters for what it removes and enables. A formal ceasefire provides a structure — understood limits and a channel for managing escalation. **Its expiration, with no successor agreement and negotiations deadlocked, returns the conflict to an unstructured state precisely as the US prepares its most aggressive economic measures yet.** Trump’s preparation of sanctions ‘aimed at forcing Iran to surrender’ suggests substituting economic warfare for a military campaign that hasn’t achieved its aims. For the American investor at or near retirement, this is a discrete escalation risk that warrants attention without wholesale repositioning. Oil hasn’t spiked dramatically — much of the premium is already embedded and crude keeps flowing — but the removed ceasefire framework raises the probability of the kind of acute incident that could push Brent through $90, the trigger to turn more defensive. Maintain the balanced, hedged position, but watch closely for any incident the expired ceasefire would previously have contained.
---
| | Sources: Trading Economics, August 16, 2026 · CNBC, August 14, 2026 · Congressional Research Service, August 2026

| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULFq59Wx6K8IEQLc3WT0Pyvuua71lbJ6BGsAc7YC3li8bWGHp2U6jhBsfnMKacVAT8dMOP3G53hgkvD4yay6vHZNgG0tRPjLfcAxnMegLX5F5BbiagBgrT3tFP9fL0qWIZhitC-nAcvFt-ZRD1v4BOWMZBdZ00UI3hUzDSxDOWzGDDmH_IQVqJ0e0v5zi2UGTz3ov-nIKX1qsuNNU2k6RlsyklKdLRtJ&c=hLWJl4Z1woPdRleDOp1DmSpApNDI15WPqpm-y4rIiMvPFNhkQQXP3Q==&ch=0j_5apTW6CwBsHvStC9APbr9PuJE-RHbVmUA86Y8E1sHVRJsMt-y1w==)

| Peter,
On April 29th, 2026, the Supreme Court issued their infamous Callais v. Louisiana verdict -- the single greatest rollback of civil rights in America since the darkest days of Jim Crow.
In their majority opinion, the court ruled to gut the Voting Rights Act of key protections for minority voters and restore Jim Crow style gerrymandering across the deep south.
Immediately Louisiana's far-right Governor sprung into action and declared a 'state of emergency' cancelling our elections and giving the Louisiana state legislature time to successfully erase one of our only Black majority districts.
In response, we reached out to Democrats across the nation with an urgent call for support. They answered. We raised nearly $2,000,000 in less than two weeks. Now that critical support is bearing fruit, a newly released poll shows Democrat for US Senate Jamie Davis trailing the GOP Nominee Julia Letlow by 4 PTS:
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULFq59Wx6K8IEQLc3WT0Pyvuua71lbJ6BGsAc7YC3li8bWGHp2U6jhBsfnMKacVAT8dMOP3G53hgkvD4yay6vHZNgG0tRPjLfcAxnMegLX5F5BbiagBgrT3tFP9fL0qWIZhitC-nAcvFt-ZRD1v4BOWMZBdZ00UI3hUzDSxDOWzGDDmH_IQVqJ0e0v5zi2UGTz3ov-nIKX1-5YYSgiKIuNw6tb1GoWn2&c=hLWJl4Z1woPdRleDOp1DmSpApNDI15WPqpm-y4rIiMvPFNhkQQXP3Q==&ch=0j_5apTW6CwBsHvStC9APbr9PuJE-RHbVmUA86Y8E1sHVRJsMt-y1w==)
---
Their ironfisted coup attempt is backfiring.
In the first election that followed the Callais decision voters showed in force to defeat all five of the amendments backed by Louisiana's MAGA governor in a landslide by over 20 pts. It was termed a 'blacklash' to the reintroduction of Jim Crow policies in Louisiana.
Now, we've gone from the brink of the extinction of Democratic power in Louisiana to the verge of flipping a Deep South US Senate seat -- all thanks to the tens of thousands of Democrats from every corner of this country who came to our aid during our darkest days.
In case you don't know Jamie, he is a successful farmer from rural Louisiana working the same delta soil that his grandfather worked as a sharecropper. When he wins in November he will be the first Black man ever elected to US Senate in Louisiana history.
The Louisiana Democratic Party is working in lockstep with Jamie's campaign and we just held a statewide bus tour of all of Louisiana's 60 Parishes (what we call counties in Louisiana) to get Jamie in front of voters across the state.
We are catalyzing the backlash and Louisiana is ready to go Blue. We are registering voters, running ads, knocking doors, and doing everything in our power to get Jamie along with our slate of Democratic candidates across the finish line this November.
The Louisiana Democratic Party is among the least funded Democratic parties in the nation. To flip Louisiana blue we need your support. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch calls herself a conservative. She says it often, and loudly -- especially now that she wants to be your governor. But a title is not a record. And when you look at what Lynn Fitch actually does when conservatives need her, a very different picture comes into focus.
Consider the biggest Second Amendment victory in ninety years.
In 2025, Congress zeroed out the National Firearms Act's $200 tax on suppressors, short-barreled rifles, and short-barreled shotguns. Then, on August 5, a federal court in Texas ruled in _Silencer Shop Foundation v. ATF_ that once the tax hit zero, the NFA's entire registration scheme -- the Form 4, the fingerprints, the endless waiting -- lost its constitutional footing. No tax, no power, no permission slip.
But because the Supreme Court recently ended nationwide injunctions, the ruling protects only the parties who actually joined the case. Fifteen states signed on to secure that right for their citizens. Texas. Louisiana. Georgia. Alaska. Montana. Eleven more. Our neighbors in Louisiana are covered today. Mississippi is not -- because Lynn Fitch did not join.
Fifteen attorneys general understood the stakes and acted. Mississippi's did not. And this is not the first time.
When nineteen attorneys general sent Costco a warning over its DEI policies, Fitch's name was missing. When you look for her in the fights that define the conservative movement, she is too often absent -- even as she climbs the ranks of the National Association of Attorneys General, an organization that has drifted steadily to the left. She shows up for the cameras and the credentials. She goes missing when it is time to stand and fight.
That is the difference between being a conservative and playing one on television.
Her defenders will point to _Dobbs_. And yes -- Fitch's office argued the case that overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and she deserves credit for it. But one landmark case, however historic, does not buy a lifetime pass, and it cannot be paraded across every campaign ad to paper over a pattern of absence everywhere else. Conservatives are not asking what Lynn Fitch did once. We are asking what she is doing now -- and on the Second Amendment, the answer is nothing.
Here at home, the problem is even more direct. Mississippi's own law, Section 97-37-31, makes owning a suppressor a crime unless you are "duly authorized under federal law." We wrote our dependence on Washington into our own statute. As other states shake off the NFA, Mississippi keeps its citizens tethered to a federal permission slip -- and our Attorney General has done nothing to change it.
Mississippians deserve better than a conservative in name only. Attorney General Fitch should explain why she left Mississippi gun owners out of a lawsuit that fifteen other states joined, and she should act now to win us the same protection. And our Legislature should not wait on her -- lawmakers should repeal the federal-authorization language in Section 97-37-31 so that no Mississippian's rights depend on Lynn Fitch finally deciding to show up.
Conservatism is not a slogan you print on a campaign banner. It is what you do when the fight is hard and the cameras are off. By that measure, Lynn Fitch has a great deal to answer for -- and Mississippi gun owners are still waiting.

| | **Just Eight Vessels Crossed Hormuz on a Recent Day, Against 130+ Before the War — Yet 9 Million Barrels a Day Still Flow. Middle Eastern Producers Are Covertly Moving Crude Under US Escort. Here Is Why This Hidden System Sets Your Oil Price.**
---
| | A remarkable detail is quietly reshaping the oil market: Middle Eastern producers are covertly moving millions of barrels of crude through Hormuz, helping limit further price gains even as the diplomacy deteriorates. **The disconnect is striking. Just eight vessels crossed Hormuz on a recent Monday, against more than 130 before the US and Israel attacked February 28 — yet Energy Secretary Chris Wright said oil exports through Hormuz have reached a seven-day moving average of 9 million barrels per day thanks to the US military.**
---
| | For your portfolio, the reconciliation of eight ships with 9 million barrels reveals the covert architecture now moving Gulf oil. Fewer vessels transit, but those that do move under US naval escort, often larger, increasingly with transponders off. **Total Gulf oil flows average around 15 million barrels per day including pipelines, Wright said — the region is finding workarounds, covert seaborne transits and overland pipelines, to keep crude reaching the market despite the collapse in visible ship traffic.** This is why oil hasn’t spiked toward the spring’s $126 even as the ceasefire expires: physical supply is getting through via a covert, militarized, multi-channel system the ‘eight ships’ figure obscures. For the American investor, this is the single most important factor keeping oil range-bound. The range breaks to the upside only if the covert system itself is disrupted — if the naval escort is withdrawn or overwhelmed. Watch the flow figures, not the ship counts: the 15-million-barrel total flow is the number that determines price.

### Why it's not enough to point out conservative hypocrisy about animals
| | [Astra Taylor](https://substack.com/@astrataylor) and [Aaron Regunberg](https://substack.com/@aaronregunberg)

Anyone following the Michigan Senate race knows that the Republicans have their knives out for Abdul El-Sayed (and that some corporate Dems do as well). But you might be surprised by the GOP's latest attack. According to the official @Republicans X account "Abdul is a puppy killer."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f94006c4-1c77-45e9-8078-e06f38122eb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That image was followed by a sensational link to a _Daily Mail_ piece claiming that during El-Sayed's stint as executive director of the Detroit Health Department, Detroit's Animal Control was a "slaughterhouse," euthanizing thousands of homeless cats and dogs. Memes with variations of this claim have been spreading like wildfire through MAGA networks, inciting countless angry (and extremely racist) responses. On August 14th the National Republican Senatorial Committee (NRSC) issued a[ press release](https://substack.com/redirect/7b296608-b929-4b14-a2e5-a535145c9f45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) touting the launch of "'Dogs Against Abdul' to Defeat El-Sayed in November." Spencer Pratt[ jumped](https://substack.com/redirect/1b072fae-547e-498d-b357-b6dfa1ac0447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the bandwagon: "Abdul El-Sayed ran a 'slaughterhouse' that killed 4,000+ kittens and dogs. Sounds familiar, LA? This is just what communists do. I don't trust ANYONE who hates dogs. #1 tell of a psychopath is abusing animals."
To be clear, the charge is bogus. To quote[ Snopes](https://substack.com/redirect/f39d01cb-c9e8-4d28-b239-1aed47ddfedd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the ultimate Internet-myth debunking site: "Public evidence shows that while these allegations were loosely based on actual complaints about conditions at the shelter, El-Sayed wasn't yet in charge of Detroit Animal Control when the complaints first surfaced. Rather, he inherited the shelter's problems when animal control was moved from the police department's control to the health department's in late 2015." Local reporting confirms that the situation improved on El-Sayed's watch, with the city's euthanasia rates falling from 74% in 2015 to approximately 35% two years later.
Of course the Republican party doesn't care about facts. And we saw plenty of liberals online respond by pointing this out, as well as the utter hypocrisy. Remember Cricket, the dog Kristi Noem boasted of shooting and killing? Or what about all the dead animals pictured in glamour shots of the Trump sons on their big-budget safaris?
The double standards are indeed glaring and galling. But we're also convinced that pointing them out is far too simplistic a response. (And besides, when has highlighting Republican hypocrisy actually gotten us anywhere?)
Today, we have an article in [The New Republic](https://substack.com/redirect/7ca025a7-56e0-43c6-aed8-49d15d4a556d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) exploring a troubling phenomenon: How Republicans are beginning to talk about animal welfare and gaining new allies--and potentially new voters--as a result. We worry we're seeing the next iteration of a new kind of MAHA: an unlikely alliance around a set of issues that have long been progressive-coded and that the right is now angling for. Remember how a few years ago, it was almost impossible to imagine crunchy moms who hate Monsanto becoming a key part of Trump's electoral coalition? But it happened. And we're concerned it could happen again with animal lovers.
When we previewed the article on a recent episode of Aaron's podcast, [Fighting Fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/62c22602-aa01-4187-ba20-53a86adfe373?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), some listeners, predictably, went straight to Republican hypocrisy. Only rubes could believe the right could care about animals. Once again, that's too easy. As we show in the piece, reality is more complicated. Some high profile MAGA politicians and influencers are positioning themselves as the defenders of (some) animals, particularly in regard to animal testing, which the Trump administration appears to be taking real steps to roll back. As we write in our piece:
> "A movement is gaining momentum on the far right. In addition to launching a 'strike force' to crack down on puppy mills and dogfights, the Trump administration is working to rein in animal experimentation. The National Institutes of Health, or NIH, the world's foremost funder of biomedical research, has [dedicated](https://substack.com/redirect/9b137ff2-80fc-4405-af48-e179bbe7d79e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $87 million to the development of animal-free research methods, and the Food and Drug Administration has published a strategic road map to phase out animal testing. Kennedy has met with People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals, or PETA, about the possibility of turning NIH-backed primate research centers into animal sanctuaries--a possibility the NIH has reportedly followed up on. Tomi Lahren, along with fellow influencers Laura Loomer and Mike Cernovich and Republican officials including Florida Representative Anna Paulina Luna, all worked to defeat the Save Our Bacon Act, a misleadingly named bill being pushed by the pork industry that would have preempted state-level welfare protections that provide gestating sows a tiny bit of room to move."
One of the scariest things about this is the prospect of the MAGA right yoking concern for animals to racism and xenophobia--hardly a novel development in the history of fascism. (The Nazis famously passed far-reaching animal welfare laws.) Vance was being a cynical, racist demagogue when he lied about Haitian immigrants eating people's pets in Ohio, and the same goes for the NRSC and its ostensible pro-dog smears against El-Sayed.
But these ploys only work because millions of ordinary Americans do care about animals. And they should.
The right is reaching these folks because the liberal and left opposition has left a vacuum. One animal rights activist we quoted put it this way: "It's difficult to watch animal rights folks accept this embrace from the right, but at this point I honestly can't blame them. If you tell people to fuck off enough times, they're gonna fuck off. And that's what the left has been doing to animal rights activists for decades."
As we argue in the piece, it would be an ethical and tactical blunder to let MAGA uncontestedly lay claim to the compassion that so many feel toward animals. For the sake of the non-human animals we share this world with--and just as much for the sake of our democracy and all the human rights under assault by MAGA--it's time to change course.
Pointing out the right's hypocrisy on animals isn't and will never be an effective response. What we need, instead, is a politics that speaks to people's sincere concern for vulnerable creatures by actually working to decrease their needless suffering.

Tomi Lahren, along with fellow influencers Laura Loomer and Mike Cernovich and Republican officials including Florida Representative Anna Paulina Luna, all worked to defeat the Save Our Bacon Act, a misleadingly named bill being pushed by the pork industry that would have preempted state-level welfare protections that provide gestating sows a tiny bit of room to move." One of the scariest things about this is the prospect of the MAGA right yoking concern for animals to racism and xenophobia--hardly a novel development in the history of fascism. (The Nazis famously passed far-reaching animal welfare laws.) Vance was being a cynical, racist demagogue when he lied about Haitian immigrants eating people's pets in Ohio, and the same goes for the NRSC and its ostensible pro-dog smears against El-Sayed. But these ploys only work because millions of ordinary Americans do care about animals. And they should. The right is reaching these folks because the liberal and left opposition has left a vacuum. One animal rights activist we quoted put it this way: "It's difficult to watch animal rights folks accept this embrace from the right, but at this point I honestly can't blame them. If you tell people to fuck off enough times, they're gonna fuck off. And that's what the left has been doing to animal rights activists for decades." As we argue in the piece, it would be an ethical and tactical blunder to let MAGA uncontestedly lay claim to the compassion that so many feel toward animals. For the sake of the non-human animals we share this world with--and just as much for the sake of our democracy and all the human rights under assault by MAGA--it's time to change course. Pointing out the right's hypocrisy on animals isn't and will never be an effective response. What we need, instead, is a politics that speaks to people's sincere concern for vulnerable creatures by actually working to decrease their needless suffering. | | | | | | | | Originally posted on | | | | Taylor ---|---|--- | ? Trying to make sense of strange times. (C) 2026 Aaron Regunberg ? ?

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Good morning!

I know it’s early on a Monday, but I just finished up my morning run, and
when I saw the date, I had to reach out. Here’s the deal: in just 1 week,
we have a state finance deadline where our fundraising numbers will go
public.

This deadline means our campaign will have to submit a public report of
our fundraising numbers for everyone to see — including my opponent, his
billionaire donors, and National Republicans.

This is the first glimpse into our campaign that my opponent will have
since the primary. He’s going to be scouring our report to try to find a
path to flipping Michigan red.

I’m determined not to let him find one, but I need your help.

With this being one of the most competitive gubernatorial races in the
country, every donation counts to prove our grassroots momentum. If you’re

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Beyond grateful
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:

---
Team, I couldn't let the day go by without saying thank you.
I’m so grateful to everyone who stepped up, time and time again, before our fundraising deadline — whether by answering survey questions, by reading about my plans for making life better for all New Mexicans, or by generously contributing when we needed your help. Every time you've shown up for this campaign, you've made a difference.
It’s this kind of grassroots support that will get us across the finish line, deliver real progress for working families, and keep New Mexico blue. _I couldn’t have done it without you._
Since I officially became the Democratic nominee, the general election is in full swing. I am 6 points behind my opponent, and it's clear the GOP is determined to flip this seat red — they’ve already spent millions. There could not have been a more important moment for us to show that we have what it takes to win — and we did!
With our continued grassroots momentum, we are ready to fight back.
But our work is not over. November is right around the corner, and we still have a lot to do. But I know what we can accomplish when we come together. That’s how we’ve built this campaign from day one, and that’s how we’ll win.

Friend: Thank you.
💛 Deb

name: Darline Graham
subject: A mother, a grandmother, and a wife
body:
I know what it's like to live paycheck to paycheck |
---

Peter,

I never dreamed I would be in this position.

Just over a month ago, I was just a mom, a grandmother, and a wife. I was not in the public eye. I was helping my youngest daughter get ready for her final year of high school.

I’ve spent my life serving South Carolina from behind the scenes. I’ve run a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. _I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars._

I did not think I would become the first female United States Senator from South Carolina, but when President Trump asked me to serve, I knew I had to answer the call.
